item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] Cabinet approves amendment regulations on licensing of tea brokers
item.description: The Cabinet of Ministers has approved submitting to Parliament amendment regulations relating to the grant of licenses to tea brokers. The amendments were published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 2501/68 dated 12 August 2026, following the approval given by the Cabinet at its meeting held on 22 June 2026.
